enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +29: Passive: +29 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Firestorm Lore +21: Passive: Your Fire and Lightning spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Firestorm +142: Passive: +142 Equipment bonus to Fire and Electric Spell Power.
Conjuration Focus +7: +7 Equipment bonus to the DC of Conjuration spells.
Evocation Focus +7: +7 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by two.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
